outcome: Urinary incontinence symptoms (M-ISI severity, urgency, and stress UI domain scores, Urinary Distress Inventory domain scores)
Sexual function (Female Sexual Function Index-6 scores)
cohort: The study included 25 new, female Pure Barre clients who experienced urinary incontinence.
finding: The Pure Barre workout significantly improved symptoms of urinary incontinence and sexual function for all participants after 10 classes.
cross-section timing: Baseline and after 10 Pure Barre classes (within 2 months)
